metadata.title: Constant mean curvature disks with circular boundary in the $3$-sphere and in hyperbolic space
metadata.abstract: We prove that a compact immersed disk of constant mean curvature in $\mathbb S^3$ or in $\mathbb H^3$ whose boundary is mapped diffeomorphically onto a circle is an embedded totally umbilical disk.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 球面及双曲空间中的圆边界 CMC 圆盘
analysis.workSummary: 作者证明 S³ 或 H³ 中紧致浸入常平均曲率圆盘，若边界微分同胚映到一个圆，则必为嵌入且全脐的圆盘。
analysis.breakthrough: 由浸入及边界条件推出全局嵌入与显式几何形态。
analysis.limitations: 紧致圆盘拓扑、常平均曲率及边界微分同胚条件不可省略；结论不是任意有圆边界曲面的分类。
analysis.priorityReason: 由浸入及边界条件推出全局嵌入与显式几何形态。
